# Auto-generated TypeScript bridges

Files under this directory are generated by `ts2mbt generate` /
`ts2mbt vendor` from upstream `.d.ts` declarations. Do not edit
them by hand -- your changes will be lost on the next regen.

To regenerate:

```
ts2mbt generate          # everything in package.json (typical)
ts2mbt vendor <pkg>      # just one package
```

If the upstream typings change, re-run the same command. The
runtime `bridge.js` files are wired up as scoped npm packages
under `@tsmbt-bridge/<name>`; `ts2mbt` writes the matching `file:`
entries into the consumer's `package.json` `dependencies` (or
prints them when the file can't be edited safely), and
`pnpm install` / `npm install` then links them into
`node_modules/@tsmbt-bridge/`.
